title: Leadership Principles: a user's manual
source: Kindel leadership principles user's manual. Classic 14. Rewritten from an internal raises/lowers wiki; company, product, and exec references removed.
howTo: Use this when you are applying a principle, studying one, reviewing work, or coaching someone who is over-rotating.
Under is not trying. Over is the principle eating the job. Just Right is the bar.
Score the situation against a row, not against a vibe. Pick the row that matches what happened, then say under, just right, or over, and write the evidence.
Cross-refs look like {lp:ownership}. Render them as links. Agents treat them as hard links to that principle file.
These files pair with data/questions.json. Same ids. Do not add competency-cut principles here.

crossRef.render: Replace the token with a link to that LP. Agents treat tokens as hard links.
